texts: Reduced the player limit of the Battle Royale mode in Clash Arena to 100.
Community Assets now only accepts uploads from accounts at least 1 week old.
Added a way for users to edit or delete their submitted trivia questions. Accepted and rejected questions cannot be edited.
In Battle Royale mode in Clash Arena, the player's own results now have a border to make them easier to see.
In Clash Arena, fixed an issue that caused the conditionals of the form 'If the user has enough charge count, or consume HP at a certain minimum charge count' to not resolve correctly.
In Clash Arena, fixed an issue that could cause some rooms to crash when starting the draft.
In Clash Arena, 'Blacklist' has been renamed to 'Bans'. Also added the missing Enable Ban Phase option in standard mode.
In Battle Royale mode in Clash Arena, fixed an issue where the button to close the room would be disabled when above 8 players.
Fixed an issue in Community Trivia Quiz where pressing space or enter while writing a report would skip to the next round.
